title: TamilEOT: A Dataset and Model for Semantic End-of-Turn Detection in Tamil Telephone Speech
abstract: arXiv:2609.05631v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: A voice agent has to decide, at every pause, whether the user has finished speaking. Without a model of the language that decision falls back to a fixed silence timeout: set it short and the agent interrupts, set it long and every turn pays the full wait. Open semantic end-of-turn detectors exist, but to our knowledge none covers a South Indian language. We release TamilEOT: 18,485 labelled turn boundaries cut from 116 real Tamil telephone conversations, and two audio-only detectors fine-tuned from Smart Turn v3. On a held-out split of 4,168 clips from 30 unseen calls, accuracy rises from 70.30% zero-shot to 83.71% (8.7 MB) and 86.13% (21 MB); ROC-AUC rises from 0.751 to 0.921. Both models run in under 150 ms single-threaded on a laptop CPU. We also report what building it cost. translated_title: TamilEOT：面向泰米尔语电话语音语义话轮结束检测的数据集与模型
translated_abstract: 语音代理必须在每次停顿时判断用户是否已经说完。如果缺乏针对该语言的模型，这一决策只能退回到固定的静音超时：设得短，代理会打断用户；设得长，每一轮对话都要付出完整的等待时间。目前已存在开放的语义话轮结束检测器，但据我们所知，尚无任何检测器覆盖南印度语言。我们发布了TamilEOT：从116段真实泰米尔语电话对话中切分出的18,485个带标注的话轮边界，以及两个从Smart Turn v3微调而来的纯音频检测器。在来自30个未见过的通话的4,168个片段构成的保留测试集上，准确率从零样本的70.30%提升至83.71%（8.7 MB模型）和86.13%（21 MB模型）；ROC-AUC从0.751提升至0.921。两个模型在笔记本电脑CPU上单线程运行均低于150毫秒。我们还报告了构建该数据集的代价。经盲测人工听审校验的规则生成标签，在正类上正确率为95.9%，在负类上为44.4%，这……
tldr: 本文发布了首个面向泰米尔语电话语音的语义话轮结束检测资源——包含18,485个标注话轮边界的TamilEOT数据集及两个微调检测模型，将准确率从零样本的70.30%提升至86.13%，并可在普通CPU上以低于150毫秒的延迟实时运行。
en_tdlr: This paper releases TamilEOT, the first semantic end-of-turn detection dataset (18,485 labeled turn boundaries from real Tamil telephone calls) and fine-tuned audio-only models, improving accuracy from 70.30% zero-shot to 86.13% while running in under 150 ms on a laptop CPU.
